title: Create your home
timing_source: HeyGen word timestamps, token-by-token checked against submitted script

scenes.title:
Choose how
to begin.
scenes.narration: Welcome to Nam Illam. Choose Create a new home if you are starting fresh. If your family invited you, join that existing home instead of creating a duplicate.

scenes.title:
Give your home
a familiar name.
scenes.route: Create a new home → Home name
scenes.narration: Enter a home name such as Our Home. This is a label inside the app, not your street address or a login account. Then choose Create my home.

scenes.title:
Start with
one small task.
scenes.narration: Your new home starts empty. Open Pantry to record what you have, Shopping for what you need, or Expenses to record a purchase. The setup activities are optional.

scenes.title:
Make it part
of your day.
scenes.narration: Use Today for your schedule and reminders. Your household works locally without an app account. Family sharing and iCloud are optional, and can be set up later.
